text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wow... What a snowstorm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I'm lucky to have found a shop so
close... I'd hate
for this antique book to
get wet.)

text_block_list.name: Server
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but we're quite full at the
moment... Would
you mind sharing a
table?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, that works with me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that you, Cafe? I didn't expect
to be
seated next to you!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh... Yes...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm sorry if I'm bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That book seems... to be quite old.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Do you mean this book? H-how did
you
know it was on me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My friend is speaking with the one who
lives in its
pages. They are... happy to
have found a new
reader... after so long.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see... Your book... it's about
coffee.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes. This is about the history of coffee
cherry
tea.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It seems that it was considered an elixir
by many
great heroes in the past! Hehe,
so I just had to
learn more!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coincidentally... this drink... happens to
be coffee
cherry tea. Would you... like a
taste?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Is that right?! Oh, well,
I'll have to order
the
same.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The taste is a little... unique.
So maybe...
you
should start with... a sip.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Blow... So this is coffee cherry tea!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What... do you think?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It is... unique,
but I don't hate it. I think with a few
more sips, I'll come to like the
taste, maybe... One cup of coffee cherry
tea, please!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I wonder if the heroes of the past
drank
this on cold days?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Should I... ask the one who lives in your
book?
